compared_against: Every other portfolio under the same umbrella, whatever its status (PROPOSED portfolios count), and the investors in those portfolios who are not investors in this one.

cases.title: Another portfolio's legal name in drafted text

changes.text: As with Lumen Segregated Portfolio, completion depends on the issuer's consent.

cases.title: Another portfolio's short name

changes.text: The sponsor previously arranged Lumen SP.

cases.title: Another portfolio's share class
cases.why: The slot snapshot would be wrong too. This case models the text being wrong while the records are right.

cases.title: Another portfolio's issuer

changes.text: The issuer competes with Lumenfold Optics, Inc. for grid-sensing contracts.

cases.why: Blocks even when the mention could be innocent (a competitor). INV-10 names asset identifiers without exception. Counsel may want a narrower rule (open question Q2).

cases.title: An investor who is only in another portfolio

changes.text: Callum Szabo, an existing investor of the sponsor, introduced the opportunity.

cases.title: Near-duplicate portfolio name, exact form

changes.text: Atlas II Segregated Portfolio may acquire shares in the same issuer.

cases.why: The document's own name “Atlas Segregated Portfolio” must not stop the other portfolio's name from matching.

cases.title: Near-duplicate portfolio name, variant forms

changes.text: See also ATLAS II SEGREGATED PORTFOLIO.
Atlas-II SP holds a related position.
Atlas 2 Segregated Portfolio is managed by the same sponsor.

cases.why: Proposed matching: ignore case and punctuation, treat “SP” and “Segregated Portfolio” as the same, and treat Roman and Arabic numerals as the same. Open question Q3.

cases.title: The shorter name inside the longer portfolio's document

changes.text: Atlas Segregated Portfolio holds shares in a different issuer.

cases.title: Another portfolio's issuer in the near-duplicate portfolio's document

changes.text: Unlike Kestrel Grid Systems Limited, the issuer has no debt.

cases.title: Another portfolio's bank account in the payment schedule
cases.why: The costliest leak: the investor's money would be paid into the wrong portfolio. The account number matches even if the name were changed.

cases.title: A figure that belongs only to another portfolio

changes.text: If the round does not close, costs of up to US$25,000 may be deducted.

cases.why: INV-10 includes monetary figures. USD 25,000 is Lumen's and no Atlas record has it. A different format (US$25,000 vs USD 25,000.00) still matches. Open question Q1: figures may cause false positives.

cases.title: A figure written in words

changes.text: The sponsor has raised USD 3 million for a similar investment.

cases.why: Proposed: figures are compared after normalising (3 million = 3,000,000). Part of Q1.

cases.title: Short-form agreement names the investor's earlier portfolio
cases.why: Correct under INV-10 as written, but then every D1SP-C fails the gate. Expected result to be revised once G3 is decided.

cases.title: Clean documents mention only their own portfolio
cases.why: Every fixture document for Lumen, Atlas and Atlas II, and every Atlas D1-SP. The only expected exception is D1SP-C (XP-13).

cases.title: The longer name does not match the shorter
cases.why: “Atlas II Segregated Portfolio” and “Atlas II SP” must not match Atlas. A check that searches for “Atlas” alone fails this.

cases.title: A common word that is part of another portfolio's name

changes.text: The issuer's sensors are rated at 800 lumens.

cases.why: “lumens” is not “Lumen Segregated Portfolio” or “Lumen SP”. Names match as whole names, not single words.

cases.title: Umbrella-level names
cases.why: The SPC, its directors (Henrik Solberg is named in the interest declaration), the sponsor, its affiliate and the administrator belong to the umbrella, not to a portfolio.

cases.title: Figures this portfolio shares with another
cases.why: Atlas and Lumen both have a USD 100,000.00 minimum, a USD 100.00 subscription price and a USD 0.01 par value. A figure that is also this portfolio's own is not a leak.

cases.title: Investor in both portfolios
cases.why: pty_002 invests in Lumen and Atlas. Their name in their own Atlas agreement is not a leak.

cases.title: Words shared by investors and the issuer
cases.why: Kestrel Coinvest Vehicle One Limited (an Atlas investor) and Kestrel Grid Systems Limited (Atlas's issuer) both belong to Atlas.

cases.title: Surname shared with an investor in another portfolio
cases.why: Brightwater Family Holdings Pte. Ltd. invests in Atlas. Beatriz Brightwater (pty_044) invests only in Lumen. Investor names match as whole names; a shared surname is not a leak.

cases.title: Template wording about other portfolios in general
cases.why: “any other segregated portfolio of the Company” and “no recourse to the assets of any other segregated portfolio” name no portfolio.
